items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: And Bob Shottley, he's from St. Louis, he played with Charlie Creston.

ctx.x: And Bob Shottley, he's from St. Louis, he played with Charlie Creston. He's playing now. Yeah, yeah. Well that's about the same Bob Shottley. So he gets that band and Ori on the trombone and they play the plantation. Well Johnny and Dutre is playing with Dominic. Dominic's playing trumpet on down Rush with Baby Dodds. So that caused the split in the band. So Joe, after there, he leaves the plantation. In the meantime, Louie's in New York, Joe goes to New York and forms a band. He fooled around the Middle West a…
Well I wanted to play the clarinet.
